_notes: plan (플랜): the file mixed 'tarif' (13 keys) and 'reja' (27 keys); marketing/common and consoles also lean 'reja'. Standardized on 'reja' everywhere; 'upgrade' = 'rejani oshirish'. If the owner prefers the telecom-style 'tarif', the same keys flip back.

personal statement / study plan: kept the market term 'motivatsion xat' + 'oʻqish rejasi' (already used by common:docCategory.PERSONAL_STATEMENT and marketing). 'Esse/insho tahriri' variants aligned to it. Owner decision: 'motivatsion xat' is what Uzbek applicants call 자기소개서, but it literally means 'motivation letter'.

managed application: three different renderings existed ('Siz bilan birga olib boradigan arizalarimiz', 'Boshqariladigan arizalar', 'Hujjat topshirishni boshqarish'). Standardized on 'Jamoa bilan topshiriladigan arizalar' (applications submitted together with the team), which matches the glossary meaning.

'Maslahatchingiz' (your counselor) was used wherever the English now says 'the Hangyul team'; all 18 such keys now say 'Hangyul jamoasi' / 'Hangyul Univ jamoasi' as the English does. 'maslahatchi' kept only where the English itself says 'counselor' (university console).
applicant (University app): mixed 'Nomzod' and 'Arizachi'; standardized on 'abituriyent', the term the uz-consoles job already uses.
Orthography: 25 keys used ASCII ' or ‘ ’ for oʻ/gʻ; all moved to the modern ʻ (U+02BB). 'GPA’ning' uses the file's ʼ (U+02BC) separator.
mobile:login.networkError: the Uzbek still carried the Android-emulator / LAN-IP developer hint; rewritten to the customer meaning only, as the English.
36 keys had no Uzbek at all (student:v21.pay.*, mobile:v29.mfa.*, mobile:v3.agency.waitingOn.*, mobile:v4.uni.actor.*, mobile:v4.uni.toReview_*); translated fresh.

mobile:signup.consent.CROSS_BORDER_VERIFICATION.summary said Cloudflare 'blocks' automated sign-ups and listed data categories/retention that the English does not; aligned to the web version of the same consent text.
student:onboarding.goals.degreeSub.LANGUAGE added a claim ('most people start this way, it is easy') not in the source; removed.
